counterfactual.change: Reduced controller fmax from 42.95 to 10.0 (single field change) to lower steady-state speed against wall, preventing penetration depth from exceeding 0.15

explanation: Shrunk scenario has single thin vertical wall (w=0.346) and controller-driven body accelerating left at fmax=42.95 with speed ~9.3 m/s. Body approaches wall from +x side; at step 348 gap is +0.013, at 350 already -0.062, at 352 -0.138 (within tolerance), at 353 -0.175 >0.15 limit. Positional correction / collision impulse with only 2 substeps cannot prevent deep penetration when velocity is high and force continuously pushes into wall. Reducing fmax (hence steady speed) prevents tunneling.
vision_note: The red (controller-driven) circle approaches the thin vertical grey wall from the right moving left toward the green waypoint. From steps 350 to 353 it fails to be repelled and visibly sinks into/overlaps the top edge of the wall with deepening penetration.
